translations.web: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
translations.bsb: must offer an unblemished male from the cattle, sheep, or goats in order for it to be accepted on your behalf.
translations.kjv: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
translations.asv: that ye may be accepted, ye shall offer a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.
